title: Persist the sandbox handle so an attempt survives a restart
description:
epic-reconciler.ts records the attempt marker BEFORE executor.start, then merges start's sandbox / process_id / branch / base_sha only in memory. Every later pass, and every restart, calls namedSandbox(binding, undefined) and getProcess(undefined).

So on the cloud host an attempt cannot be re-inspected after the Workflow restarts — which is precisely the adoption-by-identity guarantee that made the local reconciler survive nine process deaths in Phase 3. The cloud host has the doctrine's words and not its behaviour.

FakeExecutor keys on job_id, which is why the suite is green over this. Any fix must also fix the fake, or the next regression is invisible again.

From pxc, finding b25e231d.
acceptance_criteria: An attempt dispatched before a Workflow restart is re-inspected by identity after it, proven by a test whose executor requires the persisted handle rather than job_id
